mapper.select: SELECT m.id FROM material m JOIN material_version v ON v.id = #{versionId} AND v.material_id = m.id JOIN material_processing_revision r ON r.id = #{revisionId} AND r.version_id = v.id WHERE m.id = #{materialId} AND m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.retention_class = 'RETAINED' OR m.expires_at > #{now}) AND (r.state = 'READY' OR (r.state = 'PARTIAL_READY' AND #{partialReadyAccepted} = TRUE)) AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_scope_link link WHERE link.material_id = m.id AND link.scope_type = #{scopeType} AND (link.scope_key = #{scopeKey} OR (#{scopeType} = 'LIBRARY' AND link.scope_key IN ('personal', 'library', #{ownerKey})))) OR (#{scopeType} = 'DIAGRAM' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diagram_source_pin pin JOIN diagram d ON d.id = pin.diagram_id AND d.user_id = #{ownerKey} AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE pin.diagram_id = #{scopeKey} AND pin.material_id = m.id AND pin.version_id = v.id AND pin.processing_revision_id = r.id )) ) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evidence_read_lease (id, owner_key, version_id, revision_id, run_id, status, expires_at, max_expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerKey}, #{versionId}, #{revisionId}, #{runId}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{maxExpiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
